spellbook.finance/limitations: A source missing from the list means SpellBook holds no snapshot for it. It never means that marketplace has no copies, and it never means the price is zero.
Each row carries its own updatedAt. Two rows in one response can be days apart, so compare the stamps before comparing the prices.
These are observed catalogue and buylist snapshots, not quotes and not offers. No row is a link to a listing, and buying or selling at one of them is not guaranteed.
Snapshots do not include a seller, stock availability, shipping, checkout total, or executable listing offer.
One call covers one printing. A different set or collector number is a different scryfallId with its own prices; use spellbook_printings_search to name the right one.
A Riftbound printing returns its foil TCGplayer prices as separate rows, with source tcgplayer-foil and tcgplayer-low-foil, beside the regular rows.
eBay rows are a median of sold prices over the stated dateRange with saleCount behind them, so a small saleCount is a weak number. Currency is USD unless a row carries priceEur.

description: Read every price source SpellBook Finance holds for ONE printing, one row per source, each with its own label, price and timestamp. Sources can include TCGplayer Market, TCGplayer Low, Card Kingdom retail and buylist, CoolStuff, an eBay 90-day sold median, Cardmarket, ManaPool and CardTrader. Pokemon TCGplayer finish subtypes stay in separate rows. cardId is the exact printing id returned by spellbook_printings_search: a UUID for Magic, or a catalog product id for Riftbound or Pokemon. Rows come back in source order with their own timestamps; nothing is averaged, ranked, or chosen for you, and no listing link is returned.

cardId.description: The exact printing id from spellbook_printings_search: a UUID for Magic, or the namespaced catalog product id for Riftbound or Pokemon. Required.
